name: Landing page: the hero invoice is S05's computed upgrade invoice, the proof counts match, and the CTA opens the simulator
description: The landing page shows only computed content: S05's upgrade invoice (verified in Stripe: $103.20 with lines -$14.03, $38.23, $79.00) and the parity counts from the Stripe evidence. Its call to action opens the simulator.

planSteps.description: Assert the headline reads 'Change your pricing without breaking a single invoice.'

Assert the invoice card next to the headline shows 'Invoice 2 · 2027-02-01' with total $103.20 and the lines 'Unused time' -$14.03, 'Remaining time' $38.23 and 'pro_m × 1' $79.00, and below them a line containing 'invoice.created → invoice 2'
Assert a card reads 'N / N' with both numbers equal and N at least 100, labelled 'timelines replayed in real Stripe test clocks match Tera to the cent'
Click the first 'Open the simulator' button
Assert the page heading is 'Customer timeline simulator', the URL path is /simulator, and the 'Load scenario' dropdown shows S05
